#!/bin/bash
# Q3a: several subagents IN FLIGHT. Three agent types, three DIFFERENT models,
# launched in one message so they run concurrently. A path mix-up is visible
# because the expected model differs per type.
LAB="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)"
ARM="$1"; shift
OUT="$LAB/log/$ARM"; rm -rf "$OUT"; mkdir -p "$OUT"
export TIPHYS_RESOLVE_LOG="$OUT/resolved.jsonl"
mkdir -p "$LAB/work/$ARM"; cd "$LAB/work/$ARM"
AGENTS='{
 "alpha":{"description":"probe agent alpha","prompt":"Reply with exactly one line: AGENT alpha REPORTING","model":"haiku"},
 "beta":{"description":"probe agent beta","prompt":"Reply with exactly one line: AGENT beta REPORTING","model":"sonnet"},
 "gamma":{"description":"probe agent gamma","prompt":"Reply with exactly one line: AGENT gamma REPORTING","model":"opus"}
}'
set +e
claude -p "Use the Task tool to launch the alpha, beta and gamma subagents. Issue all three Task calls in a SINGLE message so that they run at the same time. When all three have returned, reply with exactly the word DONE." \
  --plugin-dir "$LAB/plugin" \
  --agents "$AGENTS" \
  --allowedTools "Task" \
  --output-format json \
  --permission-mode acceptEdits > "$OUT/stdout.json" 2> "$OUT/stderr.txt"
RC=$?
set -e
{
  echo "arm: $ARM"
  echo "claude-exit: $RC"
  echo "expected mapping: alpha=haiku beta=sonnet gamma=opus"
  echo "--- resolver log (one line per SubagentStop) ---"
  [ -f "$OUT/resolved.jsonl" ] && cat "$OUT/resolved.jsonl" || echo "(no resolver lines at all)"
  echo "--- distinct agent_transcript_path count ---"
  [ -f "$OUT/resolved.jsonl" ] && python3 -c "
import json,sys
rows=[json.loads(l) for l in open(sys.argv[1]) if l.strip()]
print('subagentstop events:',len(rows))
print('distinct agent_id        :',len({r['agent_id'] for r in rows}))
print('distinct agent_transcript:',len({r['agent_transcript_path'] for r in rows}))
for r in rows:
    print('  type=%-6s id=%-18s models=%s rows=%d outcome=%s' % (r['agent_type'],r['agent_id'],r['models'],r['assistant_rows'],r['outcome']))
" "$OUT/resolved.jsonl"
  echo "--- stderr ---"; head -c 400 "$OUT/stderr.txt"
} | tee "$OUT/summary.txt"
